description: A known competitor written slightly differently in a headline is still a known competitor. Re-proposing one spends a reviewer's attention on a decision already taken.

cards.headline: Cobalt Analytics Ltd wins a provincial reporting tender
cards.so_what: A known competitor taking public-sector work

cards.headline: Strategix Group partners with a payroll vendor
cards.so_what: A known competitor widening its offer

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys horizon_days, candidates

rubric.condition: No candidate's name matches an entry in known_competitors case-insensitively once a trailing Ltd, (Pty) Ltd or Group is ignored — "Cobalt Analytics Ltd" is "Cobalt Analytics".
The candidates array contains exactly 0 items — both cards name known competitors and neither yields anything.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 3, including its suffix-insensitive comparison.
